stemMd: Either the museum is open or the curator is at the office, or both. The museum is not open. Which conclusion is required?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The office is inside the museum.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The curator is at the office.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The curator is not at the office.

explanationMd: An inclusive disjunction requires at least one of its components to be true. Since the museum-open component is false, the curator-at-office component must be true. The premises do not establish any future schedule or spatial relationship.

distractorRationale.c: That would make both parts of the stated disjunction false.
distractorRationale.a: The locations are not related by the premises.
